title: Mashhad mein
body:
Mashhad mein
<<MINI>>
Ye chaukhat choom kar ki hai dua har baar mashhad mein..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Ilahi theher jae waqt ki raftaar mashhad mein
<<MINI>>
Ye chaukhat choom kar ki hai dua har baar mashhad mein..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Janaze to bohot aate hue dekhe magar maine..(2)
nahi dekhe kahi bhi maut ke aasaar mashhad mein
2. Suna hai khud shifa dene ko aate hai waha maula..(2)
so ab khud jaa ke mai hojaunga beemaar mashhad mein
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Raza ke husn par yusuf ko bikte dekhti duniya..(2)
agar hota kahi jo misr ka bazaar mashhad mein
4. Suna kar manqabat maula ki mai unse dua lunga..(2)
milenge jab kabhi bhi meesam e tammar mashhad mein
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Wo chahe ghar ki surat ho ya chahe qabr ki surat..(2)
khuda wanda banade meer ka darbaar mashhad mein
author: Mir Hassan Mir
